name: igly-canvas
description: Pick from 2,400+ design templates and 870+ animations, or draw flowcharts, mind maps, roadmaps, wireframes, storyboards and moodboards on an editable Igly canvas, right in the chat.

interface.longDescription: Pick a design template (menus, posters, social posts, invitations, thumbnails) from a picker right in the chat and have it rewritten for your brand, browse 870+ animations and get your own version built in the chat, or ask for a flowchart, mind map, roadmap, wireframe, storyboard or moodboard. Edit everything by hand, export a PNG, and open it in the full Igly editor. Sign in with your Igly account.
defaultPrompt: What does Igly have? Show me around.
Draw a flowchart of our customer onboarding

positive.description: Open the library from a general request
positive.prompt: What does Igly have? Show me around.
positive.expected_behavior: A library picker opens with a Templates / Animations switch and category filters. The user can switch sections, filter and pick.

positive.description: Rewrite a template for a brand
positive.prompt: Use an Igly Canvas template to make an Instagram post for our bakery Crumb and Co announcing a summer menu with lemon tarts.
positive.expected_behavior: A copy of a designed template with the headline, brand name and copy rewritten. The board view shows the post.

positive.prompt: Use Igly Canvas to draw a flowchart of a refund request: customer asks, support checks the plan, decision if within 14 days, approve or deny, notify the customer. If denied, loop back to the customer with a curved arrow; draw an optional "offer credit" step dashed.
positive.expected_behavior: A new board with rounded boxes, a diamond decision, arrows with Yes/No labels, a curved loop-back arrow and a dashed optional step. The editable board view appears in the response.

positive.description: Arrange a board and export it
positive.prompt: On that Igly Canvas board, align the step boxes, space them evenly, then export a PNG.
positive.expected_behavior: Boxes aligned and evenly spaced, with connected arrows following. A PNG link of the board is returned.

positive.prompt: Show me logo reveal animations in Igly Canvas, then make the first one for my brand Lumen.
positive.expected_behavior: A picker with animation previews playing on hover. The assistant then builds that animation as a self-contained HTML file with the name Lumen, shown as a playable preview in the chat.

negative.description: Photo generation is out of scope: the plugin does not generate images
negative.prompt: Generate a photorealistic photo of a cat with Igly Canvas.

negative.description: Purchases are out of scope: the plugin has no payment features
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Igly plan and buy more credits.

negative.description: Unrelated request: nothing to do with design or diagrams
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: design templates, animations and an editable whiteboard in the chat.
